_comment: Road-condition layer configuration (Phase 9C). This file defines a CONFIGURABLE data layer. No live road-condition provider is currently configured, so the default mode is 'mock' (deterministic test records). All roads/coordinates below are FICTIONAL TEST DATA - they are NOT real user locations and are NOT associated with any existing traffic video. At least one real external provider (traffic-agency feeds, road sensors, etc.) can be added later by implementing a live provider against the interface in src/road_condition_provider.py.

api.note: No live road-condition provider is configured. live mode therefore reports unavailable instead of fabricating data. Env overrides ROAD_CONDITION_API_URL / ROAD_CONDITION_API_KEY can be added when a real provider is integrated (no credentials are stored here).

mock._comment: Mock records are a pure function of (road_id, latitude, longitude, timestamp): identical inputs always yield identical road conditions. record_count keeps the deliverable CSV small and deterministic.
